name: Grade 7 Mathematics Term 1 Lesson Plan
subject: Mathematics
specificLearningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to identify place value up to 9999
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to read and write numbers in words
coreCompetencies: Critical Thinking and Problem Solving - when solving place value problems
Communication and Collaboration - during pair work activities
pertinentAndContemporaryIssues: Environmental conservation - using numbers in measuring rainfall
organisationOfLearning: Review previous learning: counting to 1000. Ask: 'What is the value of digit 5 in 350?'
Teacher uses place value chart to show 4-digit numbers. Learners repeat place value names aloud.
Learners work in pairs: one shows a 4-digit number on chart, other identifies place values. Teacher rotates to support.
Learners complete worksheet: identify place value of underlined digits in 5 given numbers.
Teacher reviews answers. Learners share one thing they learned. Preview next lesson: fractions.
assessment: Observation during guided practice and collection of independent worksheet for marking.
reflection: To be completed after the lesson: what worked well, what to adjust, and learners who need follow-up.
